notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
[olist]
 Achievements have been added for the end of each level.
 We can now adjust the sound of the game and SFX without problem.
 Chest have been added in some levels
[/olist]

notes.title: Update !
notes.content:
[olist]
 Little bouncing added, physics for breast
 AIs do more damage
 Range of AI that attacks at a greater distance
 AIs have been replaced for more challenge
 Faster movement speed when sprinting on the ground and in the air
[/olist]
